implementationResponse: The initial continuous decorative Pixi ticker missed the desktop p95 frame budget at 25.1 ms. It was removed; rendering now occurs on authoritative projection changes and the repeated benchmark passed at 10.3 ms p95.
limitations: Mobile is viewport emulation on the target Mac, not a physical mid-tier phone.
Localhost timing does not represent 4G transfer latency.
Headless requestAnimationFrame is a smoke measurement, not a field percentile.
The commit field must be replaced with the frozen reviewed SHA before final handoff.
